  • Lead coach & provides inspiration for geoscience staff. Coaches and inspires a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Leads the design, planning and management of multiple, often simultaneous Exploration projects, including integration with relevant technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Budget information
  • May have a limited number of direct reports (typically 1-2).
  • Manages the relation with a large variety of (groups of) internal and external stakeholders on tactical/strategic level. Scale and severity of consequences if things go wrong are moderate/high and involve complex stakeholder management.

What is the role?

Typically as a Principal Exploration Geoscientist (Supervisor) you are to

  • Manages specific technical/discipline activities for an asset or country OR delivers parts of larger projects or full end-to-end for smaller studies/projects with a clearly defined scope. The role involves working both as an individual contributor and as a subsurface project leader of a team of geoscientists, and sometimes other discipline staff.
  • Responsible for QC and endorsement of team deliverables, and adherence to relevant technical and process safety standards.
  • Typically at EC-5, reporting to a team leader. Delivers specific projects and signals shortcomings and inconsistencies in policies and procedures, making suggestions for improvements.
  • Responsible for HSSE Risk Management and leading changes in Safety Culture. Actively drives Safety Leadership, Sub-surface Process Safety and operational/contractor HSSE, influencing decision makers to achieve improved safety outcomes.
  • Lead coach & provides inspiration for geoscience staff. Coaches and inspires a broad range of stakeholders.
  • Manages complexity of Technical portfolio and Technical environment

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full-time basis for anyone other than current employer.

  • A subsurface professional with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience
  • Good knowledge of Regional Geology

We are seeking to hire a General Counsel for the Latin America & Caribbean (CALA) region who will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day legal aspects of PTI’s business in CALA. Other responsibilities include negotiating, writing, reviewing, summarizing, researching, and executing a wide variety of agreements for the company. Furthermore, the CALA General Counsel will work collaboratively with the Global General Counsel and the Company’s international counsel to oversee and implement best practices in connection with all legal aspects of the business.
LOCATION: The location of the role is flexible and can be based in a region where PTI has an office in one of the CALA markets.
Functions

  • Responsible for day-to-day legal operations across CALA leading a team of 40+ experienced lawyers across the Region and ensuring alignment with company objectives and legal best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with local laws, corporate governance & filings, and international regulations, including FCPA
  • Negotiate various types of agreements and review contracts, including but not limited to: agreements with customers for the lease of space in PTI’s infrastructures; vendor contracts; contracts related to the lease of land and space in telecommunications infrastructure, as well as regarding construction, sale, and usufruct projects of properties and wireless infrastructure including; master lease agreements, site lease agreements, ground lease agreements; built-to-suit agreements, new tower development agreements, among others
  • Provide assistance to the M&A and Financing teams on all major business transactions, including acquisitions, divestitures, and joint ventures.
  • Coordinate with international counsels to implement consistent legal standards and practices.
  • Provide legal guidance to internal stakeholders across business units.
  • Represent PTI Legal at Board Meetings in local markets.
  • Assist in the preparation of, and revisions to, standard forms and PTI template agreements.
  • Assist the Asset Management, Lease Administration, and Ground Lease Buyout Departments with legal advice and documents that are required.
  • Oversee the preparation of corporate documents required in the CALA region and maintain Company’s legal files for the region.
  • Serve as liaison with local external lawyers and represent the Company before counterparts, local lawyers, and operators.
  • Exercise other duties or functions as required in the capacity of legal counsel to the Company.
These job functions are representative of tasks accomplished by incumbents. The list is not exhaustive; incumbents perform other related tasks.
Working Conditions And Physical Demands
Position works in a standard office environment. Standing, sitting, and walking required daily.
Qualifications

  • Must be licensed and authorized to practice law in the country of residence.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in corporate and real estate law; experience in the telecommunications and/or tower industry is preferred.
  • Must have in-house legal experience and oversight.
  • Demonstrated legal experience within the Latin America region, with a strong understanding of regional legal, regulatory and business environments.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams of legal professionals and cross-functional projects required.
  • Highly polished and effective negotiation, communication and drafting skills.
  • Self-starter with initiative and demonstrated creative problem-solving ability.
  • Pragmatic and business-focused mindset with demonstrated ability to take ownership and resolve issues with minimal supervision.
  • Proven ability to independently lead and direct its staff to execute all facets of challenging transactional engagements.
  • Strong judgment and proven ability to work collaboratively with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, flexible culture.
  • Strong work ethic, well-organized, and detail oriented.

description:
Serede São Gonçalo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Serede São Gonçalo, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Se você sempre sonhou em trabalhar em uma das empresas que mais emprega no Brasil, que está em constante transformação e investe em projetos de inovação, essa é sua chance!
Nosso maior desafio é promover e liderar a transformação do modelo de operação e manutenção de redes de Telecom, aportando tecnologia, revisando procedimentos, otimizando recursos e, principalmente, investindo na capacitação e no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Sua missão será:
Realizar lançamentos de cabos metálicos em postes ou dutos, em espaços confinados e rede aérea, auxiliando os cabistas e lideres nas instalações de armários de distribuição, caixas de emendas aéreas ou subterrâneas, espinhar cabos aéreos, retirada rede de cabos e fios e na execução de manutenção preventiva e corretiva e de proteção elétrica (proteção de cabos telefônicos) em toda a rede de acesso de telecomunicações, atendendo os indicadores operacionais definidos pelo cliente contratante e/ou pela companhia.
Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atividades de instalações e lançamentos de cabos em blocos de dg, entrada de edifício, armários de distribuição e caixas terminais visando facilitar a execução dos trabalhos;
  • Controlar o estoque de materiais de redes utilizados pela equipe, verificando as quantidades existentes, solicitando reposição, objetivando o bom andamento dos serviços;
  • Preparar os cabos no interior das câmaras subterrâneas e/ou rede aérea, efetuando curvatura e dimensionamento para as aberturas, a fim de adequá-los conforme as normas de padronização para a execução de emendas;
  • Auxiliar no trabalho implantação e retirada de postes, realizando escavações com auxilio de ferramentas apropriadas, visando a retirada ou instalação de rede aérea;
  • Preparar locais para realização de serviços em cabos, colocando sinalização de proteção, instalando escadas, andaimes e barracas, retirando tampas e calafetando entradas de caixas subterrâneas, verificando a existência de gases, através de instrumentos; atuar no corte de cabos aéreos e subterrâneos, quando necessário, em pedaços de comprimento padrão através de maquinas elétricas de corte de grande capacidade, pesagem, padronização dos cabos por bitola e capacidade, para devolução no operador logístico;
  • Dirigir veiculo da empresa, transportando pessoas e/ou materiais, sempre que necessário e quando for definido pela empresa, visando a consecução das atividades afetadas da sua área de atuação;
  • Cumprir todas as normas e procedimentos constantes das orientações relativas a saúde, higiene e segurança do trabalho, reportando os desvios ao superior imediato; realizar atividades em proximidades a rede elétrica e em espaços confinados.

Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Desejável CNH B;
  • Disposição para trabalho em condições externas, podendo incluir ambientes subterrâneos, áreas aéreas e próximos a redes elétricas;
  • Não é necessário experiência. a empresa fornecerá todo treinamento.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region.   • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Job Overview:
The Senior Survey Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Survey (Mar) discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Survey (Mar) discipline. The Senior Survey Specialist solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Survey Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Survey (Mar) team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.
Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Conduct precise and comprehensive land and marine surveys, ensuring adherence to industry standards and regulations
  • Lead and oversee all survey activities within the EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation) projects, providing expert guidance and support to the project team
  • Utilize advanced surveying equipment, software, and techniques to accurately collect and analyze marine and land survey data, including bathymetry, geophysical data, and subsea infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, and clients to define survey requirements, objectives, and deliverables for each project phase
  • Plan, organize, and execute survey operations, such as pre-installation surveys, subsea positioning, route surveys, and as-laid/as-built surveys while ensuring compliance with project specifications
  • Manage and interpret survey data and prepare detailed reports, charts, and visual representations, highlighting findings, anomalies, and potential obstacles
  • Conduct quality control checks on all survey data, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and integrity throughout the project lifecycle
  • Develop and maintain survey documentation, and survey equipment readiness, manage and coordinate survey-related contractors or business partners
  • Abreast with the latest advancements in land and marine survey technologies, methodologies, and regulations, and propose innovative solutions to enhance efficiency and accuracy
  • Mentor and train junior survey team members, fostering their professional growth and ensuring adherence to best practices and safety protocols
  • To be based at worksite based on project requirements, onshore and/or offshore
Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Land or Hydrography Survey, Marine Science, Geomatics, or a related field
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in land and marine surveying within the EPCI industry, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex projects
  • Strong knowledge of relevant industry regulations, standards, and guidelines e.g., IMCA and/or International Hydrographic Organization (IHO) standards, Marine Spatial Planning (MSP), and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) practices
  • Proficient in using industry-standard survey equipment and software, including GPS, GNSS, Single/Multibeam Echosounders, various survey sensors, geophysical survey equipment, and new tech photogrammetry and scanning surveying techniques
  • Familiar with Mapping software like AutoCAD, Global Mapper, GIS, tidal and bathymetry software
  • In-depth knowledge of land marine survey methodologies using ROVs and Installation Vessels, data processing, and quality/safety control techniques
  • Strong understanding of subsea infrastructure, offshore construction, and installation processes
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented and analytical mindset, with a high level of accuracy and precision in survey data analysis and reporting
  • Up-to-date certifications in relevant surveying technologies (e.g., Land and Hydrographic Surveying, Subsea Positioning) are an added advantage
  • A proactive and curious attitude, continuously seeking improvement and innovation in land and marine survey practices
  • Ability to work in challenging onshore and offshore environments and adapt to variable working conditions and schedules
About Us
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

title: Product Owner
description:
Supercomm Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Supercomm Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Na Supercomm , somos mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos arquitetos de soluções que simplificam o mundo e impulsionam o futuro. Fundada em 2012 , nossa jornada é marcada por uma paixão inabalável por inovar e entregar valor, combinando Venda Consultiva , um forte Canal Digital e Eficiência Operacional em cada passo que damos.
Somos uma empresa com uma visão ousada. Este é o resultado de uma expansão estratégica para cinco categorias de negócio – de Impressão & Suprimentos a Telecomunicações, Serviços, Telecomunicações Enterprise e até um Banco Digital – demonstrando nossa adaptabilidade e ambição.
Nossos valores são o coração da Supercomm: Respeito ao indivíduo em primeiro lugar, a Velocidade para nos movermos rápido e aprendermos com os erros, a Valorização que gera valor para todos os envolvidos, e o Crescimento que nos desafia a inovar e a nos desenvolver constantemente. Se você busca um lugar para crescer, inovar e ser valorizado, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco!
Sobre a Posição: Seu Impacto como PO na Supercomm
Buscamos uma pessoa Product Owner que será a força motriz por trás da entrega de soluções inovadoras e de alto impacto na Supercomm. Você terá a responsabilidade de liderar projetos complexos, desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo que nossas iniciativas de tecnologia se traduzam em resultados concretos, alinhados à nossa visão de futuro e à nossa busca incessante por Eficiência Operacional e Atitude Digital .
Sua capacidade de transformar ideias em planos acionáveis, gerenciar equipes multidisciplinares e navegar por desafios com Resolução de Problemas será crucial para o nosso sucesso. Se você tem Espírito Empreendedor e adora ver um projeto sair do papel e gerar valor, este é o seu lugar!
Responsabilidades e atribuições
O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Definição Estratégica: Liderar a análise e aprofundamento de requisitos, definindo o contexto e o "guard rail" (diretrizes estratégicas) para novos produtos e projetos, com um foco especial em soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial aplicadas em atendimento com linguagem natural.
  • Gestão de Projetos: Conduzir o ciclo de vida completo dos projetos, desde a concepção e validação de ideias até o planejamento detalhado e a implementação, garantindo a entrega de valor contínuo.
  • Visão de Mercado e Tecnologia: Realizar a prospecção e avaliação de possíveis fornecedores de tecnologia e soluções, ou orquestrar o desenvolvimento interno, sempre visando a melhor abordagem para as necessidades da Supercomm.
  • Interface Estratégica: Atuar como um elo vital entre o C-level e as equipes técnicas, traduzindo a visão executiva em planos acionáveis e garantindo a comunicação fluida entre todas as partes interessadas.
  • Análise de Dados: Utilizar dados, incluindo informações do DataLake, para embasar decisões estratégicas, otimizar produtos e identificar novas oportunidades de inovação.

Requisitos e qualificações
Requisitos e Qualificações: Quem nós procuramos?
  • Graduação completa em áreas como Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos, análise de negócios, gestão de projetos estratégicos ou consultoria em tecnologia.
  • Comprovada capacidade de interagir e influenciar stakeholders de alto nível, com excelente comunicação e habilidades de relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Habilidade para transformar ideias de alto nível em requisitos detalhados e planos de ação concretos.
  • Familiaridade com o uso estratégico de dados e plataformas como Data Lakes para tomada de decisão.
  • Demonstra interesse e/ou experiência prévia em projetos de Inteligência Artificial e outras tecnologias emergentes.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) ou frameworks de inovação (Design Thinking).
  • Certificações em Gestão de Projetos (PMP, CSM) ou Gestão de Produtos (CSPO) são um diferencial.
  • Visão de negócio apurada e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Familiaridade com linguagens de programação para definição de requisitos e fluxos/processos.

Competências Supercomm:
  • Espírito Empreendedor: Visão de dono e proatividade para identificar oportunidades e desafios.
  • Atitude Digital: Adaptabilidade a novas tecnologias e processos, com mentalidade de inovação.
  • Velocidade: Habilidade para trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico, com foco em entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Capacidade analítica apurada para identificar causas-raiz e propor soluções eficazes.
  • Entendimento do Negócio: Visão estratégica para alinhar projetos de TI aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Colaboração: Excelente habilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para trabalhar em equipe.

Informações adicionais
O Que Oferecemos: Seu crescimento conosco
Na Supercomm, investimos em nosso time porque sabemos que o seu sucesso é o nosso sucesso. Oferecemos um ambiente que estimula o Crescimento e a Valorização , com:
  • Pacote de benefícios abrangente: Salário competitivo, SulAmérica Saúde e Dental, Icatu Seguros, Swile (TotalPass) e PLR.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo: Oportunidades de crescimento e plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI), com treinamentos e capacitações internas alinhados às suas metas.
  • Cultura de inovação: Atue em um ambiente que respira Atitude Digital e Velocidade, com desafios constantes que promovem o seu Espírito Empreendedor.
  • Ambiente colaborativo: Faça parte de um time que pratica o Respeito e a Colaboração, onde suas ideias são valorizadas.
  • Programas exclusivos: Participe dos nossos programas internos como #SuperInfluencers e #SuperIndicações, fortalecendo nossa cultura e o engajamento.

Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos inclusão em nossa equipe. Nosso horário de trabalho é de segunda a sexta, das 9h às 18h, com benefícios como vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e odontológica, licenças diferenciadas, auxílio creche, programas de bem-estar, entre outros.

title: Líder de Manutenção Geral
description:
Encarregado

Descrição do Cargo:

O Encarregado de Manutenção é responsável por coordenar e supervisionar as atividades de manutenção em uma organização. Esse profissional desempenha um papel fundamental na garantia do bom funcionamento e conservação dos equipamentos, instalações e sistemas, além de assegurar a disponibilidade dos recursos necessários para o desempenho das atividades de manutenção. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

1. Coordenação da equipe de manutenção: Supervisionar e orientar a equipe de manutenção, atribuindo tarefas, definindo prioridades e garantindo a execução eficiente das atividades de manutenção. Assegurar que os procedimentos e normas de segurança sejam seguidos pela equipe.

2. Planejamento e programação de atividades: Elaborar o planejamento das atividades de manutenção, considerando as demandas e prioridades da organização. Programar os serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, bem como as inspeções periódicas nos equipamentos e instalações.

3. Manutenção preventiva: Garantir a realização das atividades de manutenção preventiva de acordo com o cronograma estabelecido. Isso inclui a lubrificação, limpeza, ajustes e troca de peças conforme as recomendações dos fabricantes e normas técnicas.

4. Manutenção corretiva: Coordenar a equipe na resolução de problemas emergenciais, definindo as ações necessárias para a correção e reparo de equipamentos e sistemas. Assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos e materiais para a execução das atividades de manutenção corretiva de forma ágil.

5. Controle de estoque: Gerir o estoque de peças, materiais e ferramentas utilizados na manutenção, garantindo o suprimento adequado para as atividades programadas e emergenciais. Realizar o controle de entrada e saída de materiais, bem como a organização e conservação do almoxarifado.

6. Monitoramento e controle de indicadores: Acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho da equipe de manutenção, como tempo médio de reparo, disponibilidade dos equipamentos e custos de manutenção. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar ações para otimizar a eficiência e reduzir os custos.

7. Gestão de fornecedores: Interagir com fornecedores de serviços e materiais de manutenção, buscando as melhores condições de contratação e negociação. Avaliar o desempenho dos fornecedores e garantir a qualidade dos serviços e materiais entregues.

Requisitos:

- Formação técnica em área relacionada à manutenção, como Eletrotécnica, Mecânica ou áreas afins.

- Experiência prévia em cargos de liderança na área de manutenção.

- Conhecimentos sólidos em técnicas e práticas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva.

- Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

- Conhecimento em normas de segurança e regulamentações relacionadas à manutenção.

- Capacidade de planejamento, organização e gestão de recursos.

- Conhecimento em sistemas informatizados de gestão de manutenção será um diferencial.

We are seeking a Multi-Site Leader to join our First Mile team in Rio de Janeiro, RJ. In this role, you will provide inspiring and supportive leadership across multiple operational sites. At the same time, you won’t hesitate to roll up your sleeves and get involved when needed.
You will be directly responsible for developing a team of Shift Managers and their direct reports, while reporting to the Senior Operations Manager. The quality of your leadership will be key to your success. You will tactfully motivate and inspire your teams to do their best work while planning schedules and activities that balance their needs with those of the business.
Another key aspect of the role is leading process improvement projects aimed at streamlining operations for both yourself and the teams you support. The ideas, innovations, and bold steps you take to challenge the status quo may be adopted across the Amazon network. This is a unique opportunity, and it’s yours for the taking.
Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities
Your role will be pivotal in the overall management, control, organization, and direction of the SCP (Seller Processing Center). Your responsibilities will include, among others:

  • Maintaining health and safety standards within your area of responsibility while promoting and fostering a strong safety culture on site
  • Becoming proficient in specific large-scale processes and activities within SCPs, such as 5S audits
  • Managing meaningful data collection within the inventory control and systems environment, and updating operational metrics on an hourly basis
  • Striving to achieve productivity targets, reduce cost per unit, eliminate errors, and ensure an outstanding customer and seller experience
  • Collaborating closely with other support teams such as HR, Finance, Facilities, Safety and Security, and IT on staffing plans, schedules, and performance levels
  • Driving progressive process improvements and contributing to cross-functional Six Sigma initiatives within your sites and across the broader Amazon Transportation network in Brazil
Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Employee and performance management experience (leading large and diverse teams)
  • Expertise in two or more production or supply chain areas
  • Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements, also analyze the data you generate
  • Advanced level in Excel (vlookup, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros);
  • Fluent Portuguese and advanced English;
  • Available to travel 20% of the time to visit SCPs in your regional
Preferred Qualifications
  • Completed master’s degree or MBA
  • Experience with Kaizen and Lean methodologies and related techniques

Job Description
Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!
Estamos buscando um Consultor de Engenharia de Dados para se juntar à nossa equipe em tempo integral na modalidade de Pessoa Jurídica. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e gerenciar pipelines de dados e realizar monitoramento de problemas no ambiente de dados.
Responsibilities and assignments

  • Desenvolver e Gerenciar Pipelines de Dados: Garantir a integridade, disponibilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência das informações da pipeline de dados e informações disponibilizadas para a empresa utilizando boas práticas de ETL/ELT e frameworks de dados distribuídos;
  • Monitoramento e Solução de Problemas: Monitorar, realizar testes regulares e solucionar problemas no ambiente de dados da PRIO;
  • Ingestão e Processamento de Dados: Responsável por desenvolver, otimizar e corrigir processos para grandes volumes de dados;
  • Estratégia de Desenvolvimento: Assegurar boas práticas, código limpo, testes automatizados e qualidade nas implantações;
  • Colaboração Multifuncional: Trabalhar com equipes para entender requisitos de dados e traduzir em soluções técnicas;
  • Segurança e Governança de Dados: Garantir conformidade com as melhores práticas;
  • Arquitetura de Dados: Projetar, desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar soluções de arquitetura de dados;
  • Documentação: Documentar arquitetura, pipelines e processos para manutenção e continuidade;
  • Comunicação Clara: Assegurar compreensão compartilhada da arquitetura de dados entre as equipes.
Requirements And Qualifications
Requisitos:
  • Experiência com SQL e BigQuery: Criação de consultas e procedures otimizadas;
  • Integração de Dados via APIs: Utilização de APIs para integração e consumo de dados;
  • Processo Completo de Dados: Conhecimento em ingestão, transformação, armazenamento e disponibilização de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Ferramentas de Processamento de Dados: Experiência com SQL, Teradata, DataFactory, Microsoft Fabric e outras ferramentas;
  • Ferramentas de ETL: Experiência com ferramentas de ETL e integração de dados;
  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções de Armazenamento: Conhecimento avançado em Data Lakes, Data Warehouses e Lakehouses;
  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e/ou Java.
Additional information
Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?
Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)
Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!
Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!
Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.
Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.
Nosso ambiente de trabalho
Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.
Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Company Description
Do you want to work on the largest healthcare platform in the WORLD ?
We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner Group company, present in 13 countries, responsible for serving more than 55 million patients and processing more than 15 million appointments per month!
We currently have more than 2 million healthcare professionals in our database, totaling approximately 10 million patient evaluations to date.
Our mission is to “help people live longer, healthier lives.”
Through a diverse range of services, we are able to serve different audiences: our marketplace, which allows patients to schedule and evaluate appointments and doctors at any time of the day or night; and our SaaS system (Software as a Service) aimed at optimizing office management, patient flow and online bookings. All this through an internet platform and our iOS/Android apps.
Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive and welcoming team where each individual can excel and contribute their best.
Job Description
We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-driven Revenue Operations Manager to lead our revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment (B2C2B). This role will oversee the entire revenue lifecycle across Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, and Customer Success Ops, ensuring alignment, efficiency, and growth across each stage of the customer journey.
As part of Doctoralia, the leading digital healthcare platform in Brazil and part of the Docplanner Group, you will play a key role in unlocking scalable growth by enabling data-driven decisions, optimizing operational processes, and ensuring seamless execution across go-to-market functions.
Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end revenue operations strategy for the Individual Doctors segment;
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and CS leadership to design, execute, and optimize lead-to-revenue processes;
  • Build and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and forecasting tools to track funnel performance, conversion rates, and growth drivers;
  • Lead systems and tooling enhancements (CRM, marketing automation, customer platforms) to enable scalability and visibility;
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and lead cross-functional initiatives to solve them;
  • Create lead scoring, routing, and segmentation logic to improve acquisition efficiency;
  • Design playbooks and workflows to drive adoption and retention across the funnel;
  • Ensure governance, data hygiene, and operational rigor across revenue platforms
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or similar (MBA is a plus);
  • Solid experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Growth Operations roles;
  • Experience managing cross-functional revenue funnels (Marketing → Sales → CS);
  • Proficiency in CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or Pipedrive), BI tools (Looker, Tableau), and Excel/Google Sheets;
  • Strong analytical and modeling skills (SQL or data querying is a plus);
  • Fluency in Portuguese; business English required.
Key Competencies
  • Analytical Thinking: Able to interpret data to inform strategy and drive decisions;
  • Revenue Orientation: Understands the full funnel impact of operations on growth;
  • Process Optimization: Passion for reducing inefficiencies and building scalable systems;
  • Collaboration: Skilled at aligning cross-functional stakeholders and driving action;
  • Ownership Mentality: Bias toward execution and continuous improvement.
Additional Information

  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;

  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;

  • Birthday Day Off;

  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;

We are building teams to bring the very best open source networking software to market in a well integrated and opinionated stack that brings the latest hyperscaler innovation to end users and enterprise customers.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimize Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. You will have a good chance of success if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking, with a special interest in the interface of hardware ASICs for acceleration and software for innovation and control. We value experience in open switch initiatives such as SoNIC and DENT, and upstream experience with components such as routing, kernel networking, eBPF, DNS, firewalls and load balancers. Our selection process is rigorous and requires work from the candidate as six to eight interviews over a period of months. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation, security and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, Private Clouds, MAAS and Kubernetes across a broad range of devices and use cases.
Location : we have network software engineering roles in APAC (Top-of-Rack switches) and Americas (SmartNIC/DPU) time zones.
What your day will look like

  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Participate upstream and deliver the Ubuntu SoNIC stack
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the data center
  • Write high-quality, well-designed, fast, secure and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality fixes
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in C/C++ and at least one of Rust, Python or Golang
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies: SONIC / SAI, kernel (e.g. eBPF, AF_XDP), DPDK, Switchdev, OVN, Open vSwitch.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world every day. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Sobre a Empresa Top Transfer :
Desde 2013, a nossa empresa se destaca no mercado de transfers e city tours no Rio de Janeiro, oferecendo praticidade e excelência na experiência do cliente. Com uma frota preparada e uma equipe com experiência internacional, garantimos os mais altos padrões de atendimento, segurança e qualidade, abrangendo Transportes, Receptivos, City Tours, Transporte Executivo ou VIP.
Somos a empresa mais bem avaliada em nossa categoria no Google e TripAdvisor. Nossa missão é conectar pessoas aos seus destinos, proporcionando experiências inesquecíveis e belas recordações.
Venha fazer parte deste time de pessoas incríveis e crescer com a Top Transfer!
Estamos em busca de um Analista Sênior de Tecnologia para atuação com plataformas de ecommerce e marketplace, garantindo a integração dos sistemas, a otimização de processos e a resolução de problemas técnicos.
Confira abaixo as responsabilidades e requisitos desta função:
Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar e monitorar a integração de produtos, pedidos e estoques da empresa e os marketplaces.
  • Atuar no suporte técnico, identificando e resolvendo problemas relacionados a cadastros, integração de sistemas, falhas em pedidos e inconsistências nos dados.
  • Implementar melhorias para otimizar a performance das vendas nos marketplaces e no e-commerce da empresa.
  • Configurar, testar e validar novas integrações e atualizações de plataformas.
  • Analisar métricas e relatórios de desempenho para identificar oportunidades de crescimento.

  • Garantir a correta categorização e descrição dos produtos, otimizando SEO dentro das plataformas e do e-commerce.
  • Acompanhar tendências e mudanças nos marketplaces, propondo ajustes e inovações.
  • Manter as plataformas de MarketPlace atualizadas e atrativas através das boas práticas de cada e análise da concorrência para que nossa conversão aumente.
  • Levantar e interpretar dados identificando oportunidades, a fim de conduzir ações para o desenvolvimento da performance.
  • Estudar todas plataformas, analisando serviços, concorrentes, precificação e fazendo os devidos ajustes para aumento de vendas.
  • Pesquisar e implementar apps de IA para melhoria de processos e tomadas de decisão mais assertivas.
Requisitos de Experiência:
  • Experiência com plataformas de marketplace (ex: Decolar, Get Your Guide ) e E-commerce.
  • Familiaridade com XML, JSON e Webhooks para automação de processos será um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de analisar dados e gerar insights a partir de ferramentas como Google Analytics ou Power BI.
  • Noções de SQL para consultas básicas e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento de SEO aplicado a e-commerces e marketplaces.
  • Experiência em suporte técnico e resolução de incidentes.
  • Graduação em cursos de Tecnologia.
Requisitos Comportamentais:
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas e stakeholders.
  • Proatividade na busca por soluções e otimização de processos.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes para evitar erros operacionais.
  • Capacidade de lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
  • Resiliência para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com alta demanda.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com diferentes áreas.
Informações de Contratação:
  • Local de Trabalho: cidade do Rio de Janeiro ou Home Office.
  • Atuação em modelo PJ.
  • 8h por dia, segunda sexta com escala flexível e reduzida para eventual suporte aos finais de semana.
  • Benefícios:
  • Plano de bonificações baseadas em metas de lucratividade e eficiência operacional;
  • Flexibilidade no horário de trabalho, alinhado ao formato home office;
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional através de treinamentos e workshops (universidade corporativa).

Role Summary

We are seeking a commercially minded, qualified accountant for our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro.This is a newly created leadership position suited for someone who thrives in a dynamic, fast paced environment and who can partner with senior stakeholders and functions to drive financial performance, compliance and process excellence. This role will be primarily single-handed, with some support from group functions. The successful candidate will act as a local conduit for regulatory and tax issues, oversee day-to-day financial operations, report to group finance and support the local Managing Director in Rio as well as being a business partner to the local divisional heads.

The ideal candidate will bring solid international experience, ideally in a regulated and multi-currency setting and be comfortable navigating operational complexity with a clear focus on execution and delivery.

What you’ll be doing

  • Finance leadership and control
  • Oversee end-to-end finance operations for Brazil.
  • Ensure integrity, accuracy and timeliness of monthly and quarterly management reporting, with clear commentary and insight.
  • Develop and maintain robust financial controls and ensure compliance with group policies and local regulatory requirements.
  • Reporting and compliance
  • Lead the preparation of monthly management accounts, variance analysis and KPI reporting.
  • Ensure all statutory reporting obligations are met, including annual financial statements, federal and state tax filings.
  • Liaise with auditors and manage the audit process for the Brazil office.
  • Support the Tax function in managing transfer pricing arrangements and ensuring compliance with international tax regulations.
  • Process improvement and transformation
  • Drive continuous improvement of financial processes and internal controls, including greater automation and system optimisation.
  • Lead targeted initiatives to reduce time to close, improve working capital and streamline end-to-end processes.
  • Promote and implement best practices across financial operations in collaboration with global finance leadership.
  • Team development and collaboration
  • Foster a collaborative relationship with central Finance, Operations, Legal, HR and other global stakeholders.
  • Strategic projects and expansion
  • Act as finance lead for strategic or ad-hoc projects related to regional growth, restructuring or system upgrades.
  • Support M&A activity or new office launches from a finance operations and control perspective.

What we’re looking for

We welcome applications from candidates who share our Company Values and key attributes, as follows:

  • Integrity and respect – acting thoughtfully and ethically to do the right thing, and to promote and foster a respectful work environment for all.
  • Drive – self-motivation and the desire and commitment to succeed, deliver excellence and make positive change.
  • Relationship building – excellent communicator to effectively build strong, long-lasting relationships with colleagues, clients and others.
  • Collaboration – working well with others across diverse backgrounds to share information, develop skills and deliver results.
  • Resilience - persisting and adapting to changing or difficult situations, and adopting a positive and focused approach.
  • Smart - problem-solving abilities, with a curious and inquisitive mind, and an openness to new ideas.

Other requirements

  • Professional finance qualification (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent).
  • Experience leading financial control or financial leadership roles, including experience managing teams.
  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and understanding of international accounting standards.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading finance functions across multiple entities and geographies.
  • Comfortable operating in a multi-currency, regulated environment.
  • Experience with financial systems (Workday would be an advantage).
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior leadership.
  • Prior experience supporting Latin and South America or international offices.
  • Familiar with tax and transfer pricing principles across jurisdictions.
  • Experience in a professional services, financial services or regulated industry.

Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Engineering Manager - Public Cloud, Python, Golang role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead one of our teams that work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to optimize Ubuntu for their infrastructure. Our team builds, tests, and publishes the base Ubuntu images used by millions to ensure optimal performance and security in their cloud estate. We aim to deliver the very best public cloud VM experience, as well as specialized images for specific purposes on each cloud. Our goal is to celebrate and enable their particular points of differentiation on their clouds, while also ensure a common operating experience for their users.
As an engineering manager you need to bring both technical and management skills to the leadership of your team. You will also need to represent the team in direct partner engagement. You'll be responsible for the stability and functionality that our cloud users have come to expect. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu image products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers.
As an engineering manager at Canonical your primary responsibility is to the people you support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and generally having a great time at Canonical. As a lead for strong engineers, technical leadership and a solid background in software development is a must, so that you're able to challenge and grow your team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
We work in Python and Golang, and expect engineering managers to be fluent in the language, architecture and components that their team is building with. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. As manager, the commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation are equally important technical responsibilities, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high performing team.
The role entails

  • Build and lead a team of engineers in your and similar timezones
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles and directly contribute toward your team's goals
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Lead modern, agile software development practices
  • Ensure a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners
  • Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Software development experience in Python or Golang
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with at least one of Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, or AWS
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Auxiliar Administrativo de Planejamento e Manutenção

Join to apply for the Auxiliar Administrativo de Planejamento e Manutenção role at Logic Engenharia e Construções Ltda

Descrição do Cargo:
Um Auxiliar Administrativo desempenha um papel crucial no suporte e na execução de atividades administrativas em uma organização. Esse cargo requer habilidades organizacionais, conhecimentos básicos de rotinas administrativas e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe. O Auxiliar Administrativo é responsável por auxiliar em uma variedade de tarefas, contribuindo para a eficiência e o bom funcionamento das atividades administrativas. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  • Atendimento e recepção: Recepcionar visitantes, clientes e colaboradores, fornecendo informações básicas e direcionando-os adequadamente. Atender ligações telefônicas, realizar triagem e direcionar chamadas para os setores correspondentes.
  • Organização de documentos: Auxiliar na organização, arquivamento e controle de documentos, garantindo sua integridade e fácil localização quando necessário. Manter os arquivos físicos e eletrônicos organizados e atualizados.
  • Digitação e edição de documentos: Auxiliar na digitação, formatação e edição de documentos diversos, como relatórios, memorandos, cartas e apresentações. Verificar a exatidão e a consistência das informações.
  • Suporte administrativo: Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas rotineiras, como preparação de correspondências, envio e recebimento de documentos, organização de viagens e reservas, controle de estoque de materiais de escritório, entre outros.
  • Comunicação interna: Colaborar na comunicação interna da organização, disseminando informações relevantes aos colaboradores, enviando comunicados e auxiliando na organização de eventos internos.
  • Suporte a projetos: Auxiliar na execução de tarefas relacionadas a projetos específicos, fornecendo apoio administrativo, organizando documentos e auxiliando na elaboração de relatórios de acompanhamento.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou áreas correlatas (desejável).
  • Conhecimentos básicos de rotinas administrativas, como arquivamento, controle de documentos e atendimento telefônico.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de produtividade, como pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) e sistemas de gestão de documentos.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Habilidades organizacionais, com atenção aos detalhes e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e colaborar com outros departamentos.
  • Discrição e sigilo na manipulação de informações confidenciais.

Descrição da vaga
SOBRE O GRUPO BOTICÁRIO
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. CONHEÇA O VAREJO DO GRUPO BOTICÁRIO
Somos um time de especialistas em varejo no Grupo Boticário e GENTE é o nosso negócio! É a conexão das nossas histórias, nossas essências, nossas pessoas, que movidas pela paixão de fazer acontecer criam experiências INCRÍVEIS para nossos clientes e revendedores. Descrição do Cargo:

O auxiliar de Manutenção é responsável por auxiliar nas atividades de manutenção de equipamentos, máquinas e instalações em uma empresa. Esse profissional desempenha um papel fundamental no suporte às operações de manutenção, garantindo o funcionamento adequado dos equipamentos e contribuindo para a eficiência e produtividade da organização. Abaixo estão algumas das principais responsabilidades desse cargo:

Responsabilidades:

  • Suporte na Manutenção: Auxiliar na realização de manutenções corretivas, preventivas e preditivas em equipamentos e máquinas, seguindo as orientações e procedimentos estabelecidos pelo departamento de manutenção.
  • Inspeção e Diagnóstico: Realizar inspeções periódicas nos equipamentos e instalações, identificar falhas, desgastes ou danos, e reportar ao superior imediato para providenciar as devidas correções.
  • Reparos e Trocas: Executar reparos simples em equipamentos e componentes, como substituição de peças, ajustes e lubrificação, sob a supervisão de um profissional mais experiente.
  • Registro de Atividades: Manter registros atualizados das atividades de manutenção realizadas, incluindo informações sobre as intervenções feitas, peças substituídas e tempo gasto, contribuindo para um histórico confiável e facilitando futuras análises e diagnósticos.
  • Suporte na Organização: Apoiar a equipe de manutenção na organização do local de trabalho, controle de estoque de peças e materiais, e na limpeza e conservação das ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados.
  • Segurança e Qualidade: Seguir rigorosamente as normas de segurança estabelecidas pela empresa, utilizando os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) adequados. Contribuir para a qualidade do trabalho realizado, seguindo os padrões e procedimentos de manutenção estabelecidos.
  • Aprendizado Contínuo: Buscar constantemente o aprimoramento técnico, participando de treinamentos, workshops e cursos relacionados à área de manutenção, a fim de ampliar seus conhecimentos e habilidades.

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou profissionalizante em área relacionada à manutenção industrial ou elétrica.
  • Experiência prévia em atividades de manutenção industrial.
  • Conhecimento básico de princípios e procedimentos de manutenção.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas e equipamentos utilizados em manutenção.
  • Habilidades básicas de diagnóstico e reparos em equipamentos.
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança relacionadas à manutenção industrial.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe.
  • Boas habilidades de comunicação e organização.
  • Disponibilidade para realizar atividades em diferentes turnos, quando necessário.
  • Atitude pró-ativa, diligente e focada na qualidade do trabalho realizado.

Realização de investigações de acidentes de trabalho, identificando suas causas raízes e propondo medidas de prevenção para evitar recorrências. Isso envolve coletar informações, entrevistar envolvidos, analisar evidências e elaborar relatórios conclusivos.

Promover uma cultura de segurança no ambiente de trabalho, estimulando a participação e o engajamento dos colaboradores em ações preventivas. Estabelecer canais de comunicação efetivos para relatar incidentes, sugerir melhorias e promover a troca de informações relacionadas à segurança.

description:

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

Responsibilities

  • Perform well tie-in workflows and integrate seismic data with well data to ensure accurate correlations, velocity modeling, and structural modeling.
  • Conduct seismic interpretation workflows, including the analysis and interpretation of seismic data to identify geological structures and delineate reservoirs.
  • Analyze and interpret seismic attributes to enhance understanding of reservoir geology and identify areas of interest.
  • Support users in the development and use of geophysical workflows within interpretation tools.
  • Prepare training materials (PowerPoint, videos) and lead training sessions on geophysical workflows and techniques.
  • Clarify technical questions related to geophysical tools and their results.
  • Perform testing and validation of new software versions (user acceptance testing), ensuring that the tools meet geophysical requirements.
  • Interact with multidisciplinary teams, providing technical geophysical support to other professionals such as geologists and engineers.
  • Lead initiatives for the development of improvements and plug-ins in geophysical interpretation software, collaborating with clients and internal teams.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Geophysics or Geology, with preference for candidates with an applied Master's degree.
  • Advanced English.
  • Excellence in interpersonal communication and proactivity.
  • Knowledge of seismic interpretation workflows, well tie-in, velocity modeling, and structural modeling.
  • Familiarity with geophysical interpretation software and data integration.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, especially in geoscience projects.

Gerente de Negócios e Parcerias | Parque Bondinho Pão de Açúcar

Estamos buscando um profissional dinâmico e estratégico para assumir a posição de Gerente de Negócios B2B, com foco no relacionamento com o trade turístico e aumento do faturamento de agências e OTAs, comercialização de eventos, cotas de patrocínio e gestão de lojistas.

A pessoa Gerente de Negócios e Parcerias será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas, buscando oportunidades de negócios inovadoras e estabelecendo parcerias estratégicas para impulsionar o crescimento da empresa nas vendas B2B.

Responsabilidades principais:

  1. Desenvolvimento de Estratégias Comerciais:
  • Elaborar planos estratégicos de vendas para atingir metas de receita e expansão de parcerias e contratos;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e desenvolver abordagens inovadoras para comercialização de eventos e cotas de patrocínio;

Company Description

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!

Job Description

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

Your Impact

Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:

  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.

  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.

  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers

  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.

  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences

  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.

  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.

  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner

  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space

  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events

  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering

  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.

  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred

  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal

  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements

  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies

  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions

  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred

  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.

Additional Information

The Team

Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.

You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
